content.rendered:
Cast all your anxiety on Him because He cares for you. All of it. Not the parts you can find the words for. All of it. Onto Him. Because He is the One who actually cares.

The Gospel For Today | Saturday, June 13, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.”
1 Peter 5:7 (NIV)

Today’s Message

The Greek verb Peter uses for cast is the same word used in the Gospels for throwing the disciples’ cloaks onto a donkey for Jesus to ride into Jerusalem. It is a deliberate, decisive, full transfer. The weight that was on you is now on something else. You are not holding it anymore. The donkey is.

That is the picture Peter wants for our anxieties. Not balance them more carefully. Not manage them. Not contain them. Cast them. Throw them. Pile them onto the Lord and walk away lighter. The anxieties were never yours to carry. Hand them over.

And notice the qualifier. All your anxiety. Not the spiritual anxieties. Not the church-related anxieties. All of them. The career anxiety. The marriage anxiety. The kids anxiety. The money anxiety. The health anxiety. The future anxiety. The petty anxieties no one would believe still bother you. The deep anxieties you cannot find words for at three in the morning. All. Cast all of them on Him.

Then Peter gives the reason. Because He cares for you. This is not because God needs the project work. This is not because anxiety is theologically embarrassing and you should hide it. This is because the Father loves you and is genuinely interested in what is weighing you down. The phrase Peter uses suggests personal, individual, particular concern. He cares about you. Specifically. By name. With knowledge of what is going on inside your chest right now.

For a generation drowning in anxiety, this verse is a lifeline. It does not minimise the feeling. It does not call it sin. It does not tell you to think positive thoughts. It simply tells you what to do with it. Cast it on Him. He is the only One in the universe both strong enough to carry it and loving enough to want to.

So today, name them. One by one if it helps. Out loud if you need to. Father, this anxiety is Yours now. This one too. And this one. Cast them. Walk away lighter. He cares for you.

Prayer

Father, I cast every anxiety I am carrying onto You today. The ones I can name. The ones I cannot. The big ones. The small ones. The petty ones. The serious ones. I throw them onto You because You care for me. Take them. Carry them. Replace them with Your peace. Help me to walk through this day with empty hands and a quieter heart. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

I cast all my anxiety on the Lord because He cares for me. I am not the one holding this weight. He is. My hands are empty. My heart is quiet. The God of the universe is personally caring about me right now.

Go Deeper in the Word

  • Philippians 4:6-7: Do not be anxious about anything
  • Matthew 11:28-30: Come to Me, all you who are weary
